name: PM Carousel Accessible Slider
description: Integrates the PM Carousel accessible slider JavaScript library.
project_description:
Integration of the pm-carousel accessible javascript library.

 pm-carousel javascript library 
 The pm-carousel library must be installed in the /web/libraries/pm-carousel folder of your Drupal installation.

 The module requires the following file to be available:

 
 /libraries/pm-carousel/dist/pm-carousel.umd.js 
 
 The library files will be automatically installed from our mirror fork when using composer .
